simple.meaning: עָנָו (ʻânâv) is a Hebrew word meaning “depressed (figuratively), in mind ( gentle ) or circumstances ( needy , especially saintly ).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: עָנָו (H6035) appears 26 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Numbers 12:3, with occurrences in Numbers, Job, Psalms, Proverbs, Isaiah, and 2 more.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עָנָו (H6035) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in עָנָו (H6035) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: עָנָו (ʻânâv) / H6035 is traced through Numbers 12:3, Job 24:4, Psalms 9:13, Psalms 9:19 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: depressed (figuratively), in mind ( gentle ) or circumstances ( needy , especially saintly )
definitions.full: H6035. anav עָנָי (?; Lag BN 48 ) noun masculine poor, afflicted, humble, meek ; — עָנָו Num 12:3 (Kt; Qr עָנָיו is to ensure the ָ֯ according to Di Kö ii. 1. 76 ); elsewhere plural עֲנָוִים Isa 29:19 11 t. + Kt עֲנָוִים 32:7 ; Psa 9:19 (Qr עֲנִיִּים ); Qr עֲנָוִים 9:13 ; 10:12 ; Prov 3:34 ; 14:21 ; 16:19 (Kt עניים ); construct עַנְוֵי Zeph 2:3 2 t., + Kt ענוי (Qr עֲנִיֵּי ) Amos 8:4 (so Job 24:4 van d. H.; but עֲנִיֵּי Kt and Qr Baer Ginsb) — these forms shew confusion with עָנִי , which is perhaps only another form of עָנָו (otherwise Rahlfs op. cit. 62 f. Dr 'Poor' in Hastings DB ; עָנָו = humble, meek , עָנִי = passive humbled, afflicted); — 1 poor, needy , Prov 14:21 (Qr). 2 poor and weak. oppressed by rich and powerful Amos 2:7 ; Isa 29:19 ; 32:7 (Kt); (ה)ארץ ענוי Psa 76:10 ; Isa 11:4 ; Zeph 2:3 ; Amos 8:4 (Kt), Job 24:4 . 3 poor, weak and afflicted Israel (usually rendered meek ) Psa 10:17 ; 22:27 ; 25:9 (twice in verse); 34:3 ; 37:11 ; 69:33 ( עָנִי 3 , also in all these Psalms), Psa 147:6 ; 149:4 ; Isa 61:1 (|| לב נשׁברי , compare 66:2 עָנִי 3 ), Psa 9:19 (Kt) 9:13 ; 10:12 (Qr). 4 humble, lowly, meek Num 12:3 (Moses); Prov 3:34 ; 16:19 (both Qr).
